Summary: Angels are created spiritual beings who serve God as messengers, worshippers, and agents of His purposes, and who minister to God's people. Scripture presents them as real, personal, and powerful, while directing worship to God alone.
HistoricalDevelopment: Taught throughout Scripture and early church writing, angelology was systematized by Pseudo-Dionysius (c. 500) and Aquinas in the Summa Theologiae, and affirmed in historic creeds and confessions.
Interpretations: Christians agree angels are real created servants of God, while differing on details such as ranks and orders of angels, guardian angels, and how much can be known beyond what Scripture states.
